help:
usage: attn settings <command>

Read and change settings. Most apply to all profiles; a few apply to one
profile, and list shows which. Inside an attn session, profile settings belong
to the session's profile; outside, --profile chooses one when several exist.
Use attn settings <command> --help for one command's syntax and flags.

commands:
  list [--all] [--features] [--json]
        show every setting's key, scope, value and description
  get <key> [--json]
        show the value of one setting
  set <key> <value> [--json]
        change a setting

flags:
  --json                         print the result as JSON (every command that prints a result)
  --profile <name|id>            the profile whose profile settings these are; required outside attn when several profiles exist (every command)
